mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals robust labor market conditions that support corporate hiring and consumer spending, directly boosting equity valuations through higher expected earnings growth over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises month-over-month, or the Rank IC for PAYEMS is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 7.5%, it indicates a tightening labor market that accelerates wage growth and corporate profit margins, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 7.5, or the Rank IC for UNRATE < 7.5 is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in consumer spending (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a self-reinforcing economic expansion where rising demand drives supply chain activity, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (RSAFS > 12mo avg AND INDPRO > 12mo avg) fails to produce positive returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 0.25%), rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals economic resilience to higher rates, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.25 and INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing output that directly increases corporate revenue streams, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC for INDPRO is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 900,000 units, it triggers a housing market boom that boosts consumer confidence and retail spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 900, or the Rank IC for HOUST > 900 is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high consumer spending (RSAFS) and low unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a virtuous cycle of strong labor demand and consumption, driving positive equity returns through elevated corporate earnings over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (RSAFS > 12mo avg AND UNRATE < 12mo avg) fails to produce positive returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained economy (INDPRO < 95), rising housing starts (HOUST) signal unmet demand for housing that spurs broader economic activity, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95 and HOUST rises, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
